description: Defines classes and structures for HTTP response caching and a templated web application class using uWebSockets, including cache management and response handling.

classes.name: CachingHttpResponse
classes.description: Handles caching of HTTP responses, storing response data and metadata.

classes.name: CachingApp
classes.description: A templated web application class that implements URL-based caching logic.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the response buffer.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes the response, sending buffered data and optionally closing the connection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sets up a cached GET request handler with expiry logic.
